connectionDegree.description: Filter by connection degree to your account.
connectionDegree.title: Connection Degree

contactOf.description: Filter to show people who are connections of the specified LinkedIn member. Provide the member's URN (e.g. 'urn:li:member:123456') or numeric profile ID.
contactOf.title: Contact Of (Member URN or Profile ID)

cookie.description: Your LinkedIn session cookie. Accepts either: (1) the li_at value from browser DevTools → Application → Cookies, or (2) full cookies JSON array exported from an extension like EditThisCookie.
cookie.title: LinkedIn Cookie

currentCompany.description: Filter by current company. Accepts a company name (e.g. 'Google') or a LinkedIn fsd_company URN/numeric ID. URN format produces the strict structured currentCompany filter; plain names are added to keywords.
currentCompany.title: Current Company Filter

firstNameKeyword.description: Filter by first name token. Adds a strict firstName filter to the search.
firstNameKeyword.title: First Name

followerOf.description: Filter to people who follow a specific company. Accepts an fsd_company URN or numeric company ID.
followerOf.title: Followers of Company

geoUrn.description: Precise location filter using a LinkedIn geo URN or numeric geo ID (e.g. '103644278' for the United States). Use this for strict geographic filtering instead of the free-text Location field.
geoUrn.title: Location URN

industry.description: Filter results by industry. Applied to both Voyager filters and the HTML search URL.
industry.title: Industry

jobFunction.description: Filter results by job function / department.
jobFunction.title: Job Function

keywords.description: Optional companion to Search Query. When both are set, they are combined with a space. Use this to keep a primary role in Search Query and add modifiers (industry buzzwords, tools) here.
keywords.title: Extra Keywords

lastNameKeyword.description: Filter by last name token. Adds a strict lastName filter to the search.
lastNameKeyword.title: Last Name

location.description: Filter results by location (city, state, or country). Example: 'San Francisco Bay Area', 'New York', 'United Kingdom'
location.title: Location Filter

maxResults.description: Maximum number of profiles to return.
maxResults.title: Max Results

openTo.description: Filter people by what they are open to. Select one or more options. HIRING = open to hiring, GETTING_HIRED = open to new jobs, PROVIDING_SERVICES = open to providing freelance/consulting services, JOINING_A_NONPROFIT = open to joining a nonprofit.
openTo.title: Open To

pastCompany.description: Filter by past company. Accepts a company name or a LinkedIn fsd_company URN/numeric ID.
pastCompany.title: Past Company Filter

profileLanguages.description: Filter by the language(s) the person's LinkedIn profile is written in. Use ISO 639-1 codes, e.g. ["en", "es", "fr", "de", "zh", "ar", "pt"].
profileLanguages.title: Profile Languages

school.description: Filter by school or university attended. Accepts a school name or a LinkedIn fsd_school URN/numeric ID. Example: 'Stanford University', 'MIT', or '12345'.
school.title: School Filter

searchQuery.description: Search keywords for finding people on LinkedIn. Examples: 'software engineer', 'John Smith', 'product manager Google'
searchQuery.title: Search Query

serviceCategory.description: Filter by LinkedIn Services Marketplace category (e.g. 'Web Development', 'Marketing Strategy').
serviceCategory.title: Service Category

talksAbout.description: Filter to people who talk about the specified keyword or topic in their profile. This is appended to the search keywords.
talksAbout.title: Talks About (Keyword / Topic)

titleKeyword.description: Filter by current job title keyword (e.g. 'Director of Engineering', 'CTO'). Different from Industry / Job Function — this is the free-text title.
titleKeyword.title: Job Title

yearsOfExperience.description: Filter results by years of total professional experience. 1=Less than 1 year, 2=1-2 years, 3=3-5 years, 4=6-10 years, 5=11-15 years, 6=16+ years.
yearsOfExperience.title: Years of Experience
